messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. The forecast for part:310020 increased by 20% (fc:310020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €50.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.

I can do €46.50 and agree to the 1500 ppm you want, but we have to trade the chargeback down to €0. For this option, the terms are a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. A €500 chargeback is just too risky for us and would force me to raise the price instead of lowering it. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) – price for 1500 ppm packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for the revised offer and the 8D report. We appreciate the 1500 ppm commitment.

Your rolling scorecard sc:70140@2026Q3 shows 2376 ppm and 63.5 % on-time delivery. Hollerau carries that cost through sorting and line disruption, so the price needs to reflect it while the improvement plan is proven. Your offer of €46.50 without chargeback is also above our current price.

We propose the three attached packages, all at 1500 ppm. Could you make the one that works best for you your primary standing offer? We would also welcome a short cost breakdown and any cheaper casting or finishing variants you can suggest.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) – price for 1500 ppm packages
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the scorecard data you mentioned; it is correct and we are taking it into account by lowering our price to €46.00 for the package with no chargeback. Our Angebot is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We can do this, but we really need faster payment terms to make it work for us. I will ask the guys in production about cheaper casting variants, but we cannot share a cost breakdown. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Plant Engineer: From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.15 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 1.15 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.72 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN: payment terms and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for the €46.00 offer. We understand that cash flow matters to you. Our frame contract ctr:4600070140 provides 90 payment days. The 60 days in this agreement already pay you 30 days earlier. The energy index PPI-D351 fell from 137.0 to 131.9 between 2025-08 and 2026-08, a change of -3.72%.

You already commit to 1500 ppm in your 8D. Your containment, 100% outgoing inspection, should let you commit to a lower ppm at little extra cost. None of the attached packages includes a chargeback. Could you make the one that suits you best your primary standing offer?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Marek Lis
